title: Nilo hub
script:
-- SISTEMA COMPLETO DE PODERES
-- Criado para uso legítimo no Roblox Studio

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
local char = plr.Character or plr.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- GUI DO MENU DE PODERES
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui", plr.PlayerGui)
screen.Name = "PoderesMenu"

local frame = Instance.new("Frame", screen)
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 350)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.02, 0, 0.2, 0)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0

local UIList = Instance.new("UIListLayout", frame)
UIList.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)

-- FUNÇÃO PARA CRIAR BOTÃO
local function botao(nome, callback)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
    b.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 30)
    b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
    b.Text = nome
    b.BorderSizePixel = 0
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
end

----------------------------------------
-- 📌 1. PODER DE FOGO
----------------------------------------
local function Fireball()
    local p = Instance.new("Part")
    p.Shape = "Ball"
    p.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red")
    p.Size = Vector3.new(2,2,2)
    p.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,0,-5)
    p.Parent = workspace

    local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", p)
    bv.Velocity = root.CFrame.LookVector * 70
    bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5,1e5,1e5)

    game.Debris:AddItem(p, 4)

    p.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        if hit and hit ~= char then
            Instance.new("Explosion", workspace).Position = p.Position
            p:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

----------------------------------------
-- ⚡ 2. PODER DE RAIO
----------------------------------------
local function Lightning()
    local ray = Instance.new("Part")
    ray.Anchored = true
    ray.CanCollide = false
    ray.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 20)
    ray.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,0,-10)
    ray.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Electric blue")
    ray.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    ray.Parent = workspace

    game.Debris:AddItem(ray, 0.2)
end

----------------------------------------
-- ❄️ 3. PODER DE GELO
----------------------------------------
local function IceSpike()
    local spike = Instance.new("Part")
    spike.Anchored = true
    spike.Size = Vector3.new(3,8,3)
    spike.Material = Enum.Material.Ice
    spike.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Toothpaste")
    spike.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -3, -6)
    spike.Parent = workspace
    game.Debris:AddItem(spike, 3)
end

----------------------------------------
-- 🌪️ 4. PODER DE VENTO
----------------------------------------
local function WindDash()
    local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", root)
    bv.Velocity = root.CFrame.LookVector * 120
    bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6,1e6,1e6)

    game.Debris:AddItem(bv, 0.2)
end

----------------------------------------
-- 🔮 5. PODER CÓSMICO (TELEPORTE)
----------------------------------------
local function Warp()
    local effect = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", root)
    effect.Texture = "rbxassetid://241876405"
    effect.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4)
    effect.Rate = 200
    effect.Speed = NumberRange.new(0,0)

    root.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,0,-20)

    game.Debris:AddItem(effect,1)
end

----------------------------------------
-- 🦾 6. SUPER FORÇA (SOCÃO)
----------------------------------------
local function Punch()
    local hitbox = Instance.new("Part")
    hitbox.Size = Vector3.new(4,4,4)
    hitbox.Transparency = 1
    hitbox.CanCollide = false
    hitbox.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,0,-4)
    hitbox.Parent = workspace

    hitbox.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        if hit and hit:IsA("BasePart") then
            if hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart").Velocity = root.CFrame.LookVector * 120
            end
        end
    end)

    game.Debris:AddItem(hitbox,0.15)
end

----------------------------------------
-- SOMBRA
----------------------------------------
local function Shadow()
    local clone = char:Clone()
    clone.Parent = workspace
    clone.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,0,-8)
    game.Debris:AddItem(clone, 5)
end

----------------------------------------
-- LUZ
----------------------------------------
local function LightBlast()
    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Anchored = true
    part.Size = Vector3.new(12,12,12)
    part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    part.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("New Yeller")
    part.CFrame = root.CFrame
    part.Parent = workspace

    game.Debris:AddItem(part,0.4)
end

----------------------------------------
-- ADICIONAR BOTÕES NO MENU
----------------------------------------
botao("🔥 Bola de Fogo", Fireball)
botao("⚡ Raio", Lightning)
botao("❄️ Espinho de Gelo", IceSpike)
botao("🌪️ Dash de Vento", WindDash)
botao("🔮 Teleporte", Warp)
botao("🦾 Soco Forte", Punch)
botao("👤 Sombra", Shadow)
botao("✨ Luz Explosiva", LightBlast)

----------------------------------------
print("Sistema de poderes carregado.")
